questions.question: What is the meaning of D in the formula Ug = Ft/D?
questions.korean: 공식 Ug = Ft/D에서 D는 무엇을 의미하는가?
options: Distance from source side to film side of specimen

questions.question: What is the maximum geometrical unsharpness of radiograph for specimen thickness under 2 inch?
questions.korean: 2인치 이하 시험물의 최대 기하학적 불선명도는?

questions.question: What is the essential indication of IQI in radiograph?
questions.korean: 방사선 사진에서 IQI의 필수 표시사항은?

questions.question: Backing rings or strips of weldments are ______ as part of weld thickness in penetrameter selection.
questions.korean: 투과도계 선정 시 backing ring은 용접부 두께의 일부로 어떻게 취급하는가?

questions.question: The density of the radiograph shall be between minus 15% or plus 30% from the density through the body of penetrameter.
questions.korean: 방사선 사진 농도 허용 범위는?

questions.question: For spherical components with source at center for single exposure, how many IQIs are required?
questions.korean: 구형 용기 중앙 선원 촬영 시 필요한 IQI 수는?

questions.question: For continuous radiographing with RF-300EGS3 X-ray apparatus, what duty cycle shall be maintained?
questions.korean: RF-300EGS3 연속 촬영 시 Duty Cycle 조건은?

questions.question: For pipe and tubes with outside diameter greater than 3-1/2 inch, radiographic examination shall be performed for ______ wall viewing only.
questions.korean: 외경 3-1/2 inch 초과 파이프 RT 촬영 방식은?

questions.question: Based on ASME Sec.I PW-51, which condition would cause rejection?
questions.korean: ASME Sec.I PW-51 기준 불합격 조건은?
options: Aligned indications less than 1/2t in 12t length
Slag inclusion 1/5 inch in 1/2 inch weld
Slag inclusion 1/2 inch in 2 inch weld

questions.question: What is the minimum equivalent sensitivity for PSL2 weld radiographic testing according to API 6A?
questions.korean: API 6A PSL2 용접부 RT 최소 등가 감도는?

questions.question: A round indication of 1/4 inch (6mm) appeared on PSL2 weld RT inspection. Is it acceptable?
questions.korean: PSL2 용접부 RT 검사에서 6mm 원형지시가 나타났다. 합격인가?

questions.question: The RT film showed a slag inclusion of 2 x 15 mm. Is it acceptable?
questions.korean: RT 필름에서 2×15mm 슬래그 개재물이 나타났다. 합격인가?

questions.question: A weld containing 1/16 inch crack shown by radiography is acceptable.
questions.korean: RT 검사에서 1/16 inch 균열이 발견된 용접부는 합격이다.

questions.question: A 1/3 inch elongated indication is acceptable for 2 inch weld thickness.
questions.korean: 두께 2 inch 용접부의 1/3 inch 선형지시는 합격인가?

questions.question: A 5/8 inch elongated indication is acceptable for 2-1/4 inch weld thickness.
questions.korean: 두께 2-1/4 inch 용접부의 5/8 inch 선형지시는 합격인가?

questions.question: What is the recommended guide book for establishing NDE personnel qualification program in ASME B&PV Code Sec.VIII Div.1 & Div.2?
questions.korean: ASME Sec.VIII Div.1 & Div.2 NDE 인원 자격 프로그램 수립 지침서는?

questions.question: The front and back lead intensifying screen shall be used. The thickness is ______ inch.
questions.korean: 전후방 연박 증감지 두께는?

questions.question: A lead symbol B for checking back scattered radiation shall have minimum dimension of height and thickness.
questions.korean: 후방산란 확인용 납 B 글자의 최소 크기는?

questions.question: In this procedure, radiographs shall be made using:
questions.korean: 본 절차서에서 방사선 사진은 어떤 필름을 사용하는가?

questions.question: The minimum transmitted film density for X-ray and Gamma-ray source shall be:
questions.korean: X-ray 및 Gamma-ray 촬영 시 최소 필름 농도는?

questions.question: What part of γ-ray machine is used to move the radiographic isotope to the object?
questions.korean: 방사성 동위원소를 피사체까지 이동시키는 γ선 장치 부품은?

questions.question: Which part of γ-ray machine generates mechanical force to move the radiographic isotope?
questions.korean: 방사성 동위원소 이동용 기계적 힘을 발생시키는 부품은?

questions.question: Which part of γ-ray machine is connected to the isotope container?
questions.korean: 방사성 동위원소 저장용기에 연결되는 부품은?

questions.question: What is checked of the pigtail female?
questions.korean: 피그테일 연결부위는 무엇으로 검사하는가?

questions.question: It is necessary to enclose all radioactive isotopes for ______ reasons.
questions.korean: 방사성 동위원소를 밀봉하는 이유는?

questions.question: How many exposures are required for complete radiographic coverage of cylindrical girth welds when DWSI technique is allowed?
questions.korean: DWSI 방식에서 원주 용접부 전체 촬영에 필요한 노출 수는?

questions.question: In double-wall technique, when both wall images are superimposed, how many exposures are required?
questions.korean: 이중벽 촬영에서 양쪽 벽 영상이 중첩되는 경우 필요한 노출 수는?

questions.question: In double-wall technique, when both wall images are not superimposed, how many exposures are required?
questions.korean: 이중벽 촬영에서 양쪽 벽 영상이 중첩되지 않는 경우 필요한 노출 수는?

questions.question: If IQI image does not appear on one radiograph in double film technique but appears in composite viewing, which interpretation technique is permitted?
questions.korean: 이중 필름 촬영에서 한 장에는 IQI상이 없고 composite viewing에서 나타나는 경우 허용 판독법은?
